quote: For the sake of goodness and love, man shall let death have no sovereignty over his thoughts.
source: Thomas Mann, The Magic Mountain, ch. VI, Snow (Hans Castorp) (trans. H. T. Lowe-Porter, 1927)
speaker: Hans Castorp

evidence.where: Standard Ebooks transcription of H. T. Lowe-Porter's translation (US public domain), chapter 6, section 7, Snow; the sentence is set in italics inside Hans Castorp's waking reflection on the dream
evidence.edition: Thomas Mann, The Magic Mountain, trans. H. T. Lowe-Porter (Knopf, 1927)
evidence.locator: Chapter VI, Snow, near the close of the dream passage, just before 'And with this, I awake'

reason: Exact wording found in Lowe-Porter's text, italicised, in the Snow section of chapter VI. It is Hans Castorp's thought, so he is named as speaker; the Woods rendering (grant death no dominion) is a different translation and is not used.
